Evolve to the next stage in ITSM

IT Operations Management (ITOM) refers to all the technology, services, and infrastructure an IT department provides — applications, storage, networking, hardware, and software. The goal of ITOM is to ensure that everything is running optimally across every server and node. Predictive AIOps takes this further, spotting anomalies and predicting service issues before they trigger an outage.

ITOM and ITSM: A dynamic duo

IT Operations Management (ITOM) focuses on the processes IT teams follow to manage themselves and their internal activities, while IT Service Management (ITSM) focuses on how services are delivered by IT teams to users — increasingly, the same anomaly a Predictive AIOps alert catches on the ITOM side becomes the incident that Predictive Intelligence classifies and routes automatically on the ITSM side.

ServiceNow ITOM delivers a comprehensive, integrated set of capabilities — Event Management, Metric Intelligence, and Health Log Analytics — that builds seamlessly on your existing ServiceNow ITSM investment.

Exterprise ensures your IT teams have full visibility into every part of the infrastructure — Discovery and CMDB mapping keep configuration data accurate, and, increasingly, the AI Agents and automations acting on that data stay visible through AI Control Tower governance.
